findings.source_quote: “There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.”
findings.suggested_fix: In this quotation, replace “सब्त का विश्राम” with “विश्राम” so it does not specify a kind of rest that the printed source does not specify.
findings.translation_quote: “इसलिये परमेश्वर के लोगों के लिये सब्त का विश्राम बाकी है।”

findings.source_quote: “lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief”
findings.suggested_fix: In both quoted passages, replace “अवज्ञा” with “अविश्वास” to preserve the source’s reference to unbelief rather than disobedience.
findings.translation_quote: “ऐसा न हो कि कोई उस अवज्ञा के उदाहरण पर गिर पड़े”
